findings.evidence:
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct OrderResponse {
    pub order_id: i64,
    pub customer_id: i64,
    pub total_cents: i64,
findings.recommendation: Remove `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` so `GET /orders/{id}` keeps emitting `order_id`, `customer_id` and `total_cents` (the new `currency` field is a single word and needs no rename). Today partners' integrations read `order_id`, `customer_id` and `total_cents`; after this change the endpoint returns `orderId`, `customerId` and `totalCents`, so every partner reading those keys gets a missing field on the first deploy, with no **BREAKING** item in the release note (which only says "Added: Orders carry their `currency`"), while `docs/api.md` still lists the snake_case names and promises "a field is never renamed or removed without two releases of deprecation". If camelCase is really wanted, it must go through that deprecation (emit both names for two releases), be marked BREAKING in the release note and the docs, and follow semantic versioning for the 4.1.0 crate.
findings.title: camelCase rename silently breaks every existing order JSON field

findings.evidence:
/// The currency of orders that do not name one (ISO 4217).
pub default_currency: String,
findings.recommendation: Give the key a default so existing configuration keeps working, e.g. `#[serde(default = "default_currency")]` returning `"EUR"` (the currency the shop sold in before this change), and add a test that `config::load` accepts a file holding only `database_url` and `listen`. Today every deployed `config.toml` has only `database_url` and `listen` (as `config.example.toml` did on `main`); `Config` derives `Deserialize` with `default_currency` as a required `String`, so `toml::from_str` returns `missing field default_currency` and the service refuses to start on upgrade. Nothing in the release note tells operators to add the key; if it stays required, say so as a BREAKING item with the step to take.
findings.title: Existing config.toml files fail to load without `default_currency`
